ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider (Octo Tempest / UNC3944): help-desk MFA reset followed by attacker sign-in from a new IP
ucs.description: Hunts the Scattered Spider signature chain: vishing the IT help desk to reset a privileged user's password or MFA method (T1556 / T1098), then logging in as that user from a residential / VPS IP within minutes (T1078.004). Microsoft, Mandiant and Okta have all attributed this exact workflow to UNC3944 / Octo Tempest / Muddled Libra, used as the front door for BlackCat/ALPHV and RansomHub intrusions.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as reset_time values(Change.src_user) as helpdesk_admin values(Change.command) as reset_op from datamodel=Change where Change.action="modified" AND Change.object_category IN ("user","authentication_method") AND Change.command IN ("Reset user password","Reset user authentication methods","Update user","User registered security info","Admin registered security info","Reset password (by admin)") by Change.user
| `drop_dm_prefix(Change)`
| rename user as victim
| join type=inner victim [
    | tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as signin_time values(Authentication.src) as signin_src values(Authentication.user_agent) as ua values(Authentication.app) as signin_app from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action="success" AND Authentication.app IN ("Azure Active Directory","Microsoft Entra ID","Okta","AWS") AND Authentication.signature_id IN ("UserLoggedIn","user.session.start","ConsoleLogin") by Authentication.user
    | `drop_dm_prefix(Authentication)`
    | rename user as victim
]
| where signin_time >= reset_time AND (signin_time - reset_time) <= 3600
| eval delay_min = round((signin_time - reset_time)/60, 1)
| table reset_time signin_time delay_min victim helpdesk_admin reset_op signin_src signin_app ua
| sort - reset_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let CorrelationWindow = 60m;
let ResetOps = dynamic(["Reset user authentication methods.","Update user.","Reset password (by admin).","User registered security info.","Admin registered security info.","Reset user password."]);
let HelpdeskResets =
    CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Application in~ ("Office 365","Microsoft Entra ID","Azure Active Directory")
    | where ActionType in~ (ResetOps)
    | mv-expand ActivityObjects
    | where tostring(ActivityObjects.Role) =~ "Target object" and tostring(ActivityObjects.Type) =~ "Account"
    | extend Target = tolower(tostring(ActivityObjects.Name))
    | where isnotempty(Target)
    | project ResetTime = Timestamp, ResetOp = ActionType, Initiator = AccountDisplayName, InitiatorUpn = AccountId, InitiatorIp = IPAddress, Target;
HelpdeskResets
| join kind=inner (
    AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | where IsInteractive == true or ClientAppUsed in~ ("Browser","Mobile Apps and Desktop clients")
    | extend Target = tolower(AccountUpn)
    | project SigninTime = Timestamp, Target, SigninIp = IPAddress, Country, City, DeviceName, AadDeviceId, UserAgent, Application, RiskLevelDuringSignIn
) on Target
| where SigninTime between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + CorrelationWindow)
| where isempty(InitiatorIp) or InitiatorIp != SigninIp                            // sign-in IP is NOT the help desk admin's IP
| where isempty(AadDeviceId) or RiskLevelDuringSignIn in~ ("medium","high")        // unmanaged device OR risky sign-in
| extend DelayMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', SigninTime, ResetTime)
| project ResetTime, SigninTime, DelayMinutes, Target, ResetOp, Initiator, InitiatorIp, SigninIp, Country, City, DeviceName, UserAgent, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, Application
| order by ResetTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let CorrelationWindow = 60m;
let ResetOps = dynamic(["Reset user password","Reset user authentication methods","Update user","User registered security info","Admin registered security info"]);
let HelpdeskResets =
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OperationName in (ResetOps)
    | where Result == "success"
    | mv-expand TargetResources
    | extend Target = tolower(tostring(TargetResources.userPrincipalName))
    | extend InitiatorUpn = tolower(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)),
             InitiatorIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | where isnotempty(Target)
    | project ResetTime = TimeGenerated, OperationName, Target, InitiatorUpn, InitiatorIp;
HelpdeskResets
| join kind=inner (
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | where IsInteractive == true
    | extend Target = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
    | extend DeviceTrust = tostring(DeviceDetail.trustType),
             ManagedDevice = tostring(DeviceDetail.isManaged),
             Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion),
             City = tostring(LocationDetails.city)
    | project SigninTime = TimeGenerated, Target, SigninIp = IPAddress, Country, City, AppDisplayName, UserAgent, DeviceTrust, ManagedDevice, RiskLevelDuringSignIn
) on Target
| where SigninTime between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + CorrelationWindow)
| where isempty(InitiatorIp) or InitiatorIp != SigninIp
| where ManagedDevice != "true" or RiskLevelDuringSignIn in~ ("medium","high")
| extend DelayMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', SigninTime, ResetTime)
| project ResetTime, SigninTime, DelayMinutes, Target, OperationName, InitiatorUpn, InitiatorIp, SigninIp, Country, City, AppDisplayName, UserAgent, DeviceTrust, RiskLevelDuringSignIn
| order by ResetTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory @evt.name:("Reset user authentication methods" OR "Reset user password" OR "User registered security info" OR "Admin registered security info" OR "Update user") @properties.activityStatusValue:Success -@usr.id:break-glass*
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog
| EventType=/auth-method-reset|password-reset|register-mfa/i OR ActionType=/Reset user authentication methods|Reset user password|User registered security info/i
| join({#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog EventType=/sign-in/i AuthenticationResult=Success}, field=TargetUserPrincipalName, key=TargetUserPrincipalName, include=[SourceIPAddress, UserAgent, _time])
| TargetSigninTime := _time
| eval(delay_sec=TargetSigninTime-ResetEventTime)
| delay_sec>=0 AND delay_sec<=3600
| SourceIPAddress!=InitiatorIPAddress
| groupBy([TargetUserPrincipalName, ResetEventTime, TargetSigninTime, SourceIPAddress, UserAgent], function=count())

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider RMM-then-MEGA exfiltration chain on the same host
ucs.description: Hunts Scattered Spider's distinctive post-access toolchain: drop a commercial RMM (AnyDesk / ScreenConnect / Splashtop / Pulseway / Fleetdeck / Level / TeamViewer / Atera / Syncro / NinjaRMM / Action1) as their persistent foothold and then stage data exfiltration with rclone or MEGAsync to mega.nz within 24 hours on the same host. CISA AA23-320A, Microsoft (Octo Tempest) and Unit 42 (Muddled Libra) all flag this exact pairing.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as rmm_time values(Processes.process) as rmm_cmd values(Processes.process_name) as rmm_bin values(Processes.user) as rmm_user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("anydesk.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe","splashtop.exe","SRService.exe","pulseway.exe","fleetdeck.exe","atera.exe","syncro.exe","NinjaRMMAgent.exe","MeshAgent.exe","Action1_agent.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","teamviewer.exe","rustdesk.exe","level.exe","Zoho_Assist_Service.exe","BeyondTrustRemoteSupport.exe") AND Processes.user!="*$" by Processes.dest
| `drop_dm_prefix(Processes)`
| rename dest as host
| join type=inner host [
    | tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as exfil_time values(Processes.process) as exfil_cmd values(Processes.process_name) as exfil_bin from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("rclone.exe","megasync.exe","MEGAcmd.exe","MEGAclient.exe","FileZilla.exe","WinSCP.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*mega.nz*","*mega.co.nz*","*rclone*--config*","*rclone*copy*","*rclone*sync*","*rclone*mega*")) by Processes.dest
    | `drop_dm_prefix(Processes)`
    | rename dest as host
]
| where exfil_time >= rmm_time AND (exfil_time - rmm_time) <= 86400
| eval delay_min = round((exfil_time - rmm_time)/60, 0)
| table rmm_time exfil_time delay_min host rmm_user rmm_bin rmm_cmd exfil_bin exfil_cmd
| sort - rmm_time

ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(anydesk|screenconnect\.windowsclient|connectwisecontrol\.client|splashtop|srservice|pulseway|fleetdeck|atera|syncro|ninjarmmagent|meshagent|action1_agent|tacticalrmm|teamviewer|rustdesk|level|zoho_assist_service|beyondtrustremotesupport|rclone|megasync|megacmd|megaclient)\.exe$/i
| regex("^[A-Z]:\\\\", field=UserName, strict=false) OR NOT UserName=/\$$/
| Category := if(ImageFileName=/\\(rclone|megasync|megacmd|megaclient)\.exe$/i, "exfil", "rmm")
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, Category]), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])
| Categories := array:join(Category, ",")
| Categories=/rmm/ AND Categories=/exfil/
| eval(window_sec=lastSeen-firstSeen)
| window_sec<=86400
ucs.rationale: Scattered Spider does not rely on bespoke implants — Microsoft / Mandiant / Unit 42 / CISA all document them living off commercial RMMs the IT team often genuinely uses, which is what defeats single-binary detection.
